backtest_feasibility.message: Nine archive-verified folds hold out the 2019, 2022, and 2025 elections. Markov leads narrowly, but the archive spans only fifteen years and tests 7–28-day forecasts, so no model is promoted for the current long horizon.
validation_constraints: The source-vintage polling archive begins in 2010 and spans fifteen years; promotion requires twenty.
All nine held-out folds evaluate 7-, 14-, or 28-day forecasts, not the current early-cycle horizon.
National TPP is diagnostic for major-party direction but does not replace a division-level seat and crossbench model.
Model-family confidence intervals overlap; the narrow Markov lead is not decisive.
